title: Assessment and prediction of index based agricultural drought vulnerability using machine learning algorithms
study_area: Barind Tract (25 upazilas of Rajshahi, Naogaon and Chapai-Nawabganj districts), 8371 km2, 24°08'N to 25°13'N, 88°01'E to 89°10'E
key_result: Under VHI, extreme drought area grew from 184.00 km2 (1996) to 571.18 km2 (2021), and CA-ANN (AUC 0.938 for 2016, 0.960 for 2021) predicts severe and extreme drought at 15% and 13% of the area in 2026 and 18% and 24% in 2031.

method_details.scene_selection: March and April (pre-monsoon), cloud cover < 5%, path/row 138/43, 5-year interval 1996-2021, USGS EarthExplorer

emissivity_table2.note: breaks printed as 0002E185 and 0002E727 in the table body; -0.185 and 0.727 inferred from first and last rows

method_details.tm_radiance: R = V/255 * (Rmax - Rmin) + Rmin, Rmax = 1.898, Rmin = 0.1534 (V = DN of band 6)

tm_constants_as_printed.note: printed values; standard Landsat 5 TM values are K1 = 607.76, K2 = 1260.56

method_details.brightness_temperature: T = K2 / ln(K1 / L + 1); Celsius = K - 273.15
method_details.lst: LST = Ti / (1 + (lambda * Ti / rho) * ln(emissivity)), rho = hc/sigma = 1.43e-2 m K
method_details.vci: 100 * (NDVI - NDVImin) / (NDVImax - NDVImin), min and max over all pixels
method_details.tci: 100 * (LSTmax - LST) / (LSTmax - LSTmin), min and max over all pixels
method_details.vhi: alpha * VCI + (1 - alpha) * TCI; alpha value not reported
method_details.vegetation_mask: NDVI < 0.2 set to No Data before drought mapping
method_details.soil_moisture: GLDAS-NOAH SoilMoi0_10cm_inst, SoilMoi10_40cm_inst, SoilMoi40_100cm_inst (kg/m2), 2016 and 2021 maps
method_details.rainfall: CHIRPS annual precipitation in Google Earth Engine
method_details.surface_water: JRC Global Surface Water Explorer (permanent and temporary) in Google Earth Engine

ann.software: QGIS MOLUSCE plugin (CA-ANN); pixel values transformed in ArcGIS Pro
ann.hidden_neurons_source: read from Fig. 3, not stated in text
